descriptionByLocale.it:
Entra a far parte del nostro unico team LISA in Svizzera e diventa uno specialista per lavorare sotto tensione nella rete a media tensione. Insieme assicuriamo un alimentatore sicuro – con responsabilità, tecnologia all'avanguardia e un forte spirito di squadra.

## I tuoi compiti
• Effettuerai lavori su linee a media tensione come parte di progetti di espansione, manutenzione e manutenzione
• Insieme al team, crei, rinnovi e rinnovi i sistemi delle linee aeree e contribuisci ad un approvvigionamento energetico affidabile
• Dopo la vostra formazione speciale, si prende il sopravvento sotto tensione sui sistemi di media tensione e utilizzare le conoscenze specialistiche specificamente
• In caso di interruzioni, si supporta una soluzione rapida e aiuta attivamente a garantire l'elevata disponibilità della rete
• Si lavora in circuiti, così come in interruzioni di corrente e messa in servizio e gestire in modo sicuro veicoli, ascensori e attrezzature speciali
• Attuare costantemente gli standard di sicurezza e qualità e contribuire a una cultura del lavoro in cui il reciproco sostegno è una questione naturalmente

## Lo porti con te.
• Hai un apprendistato completato come elettricista a griglia: in EFZ o una formazione elettrotecnica comparabile
• Si desidera sviluppare in uno specialista per lavorare sotto tensione media e portare la volontà necessaria per imparare
• Idealmente, si potrebbe già acquisire esperienza nella costruzione o manutenzione di linee aeree a media tensione
• Il lavoro indipendente, affidabile e sicuro ti contraddistingue e un uso responsabile delle infrastrutture e dei materiali
• Lavorare all'aperto e in altezza ti dà piacere e porti flessibilità e disponibilità per diverse missioni
• Hai la patente di guida della categoria B, una licenza di categoria BE o C è vantaggiosa
Non vogliamo richieste da fornitori di servizi di personale.

BKW offre ai propri clienti soluzioni complete a livello internazionale nel campo dell'energia, degli edifici e delle infrastrutture. Usiamo circa 11.500 persone. descriptionByLocale.en:
Become part of our unique LISA team in Switzerland and become a specialist for working under voltage in the medium-voltage network. Together we ensure a secure power supply – with responsibility, state-of-the-art technology and a strong team spirit.

## Your tasks
• You will carry out work on medium voltage overhead lines as part of expansion, maintenance and maintenance projects
• Together with the team, you create, renew and renovate overhead line systems and contribute to a reliable energy supply
• After your special training, you take over work under voltage on medium-voltage systems and use your specialist knowledge specifically
• In the event of disruptions, you support a quick fix and actively help to ensure high network availability
• You work in circuits as well as in power shutdowns and commissionings and safely operate vehicles, lifts and special equipment
• You consistently implement safety and quality standards and contribute to a work culture in which mutual support is a matter of course

## You bring that with you
• You have a completed apprenticeship as a grid electrician: in EFZ or a comparable electrotechnical training
• You want to develop into a specialist for working under voltage medium voltage and bring the necessary willingness to learn
• Ideally, you could already gain experience in the construction or maintenance of medium voltage overhead lines
• Independent, reliable and safety-conscious work distinguishes you as well as a responsible use of infrastructure and materials
• Working outdoors and in height gives you pleasure and you bring flexibility as well as readiness for varied missions
• You have the driving licence of category B, a licence of category BE or C is advantageous
We do not want requests from personnel service providers.

Devenez membre de notre équipe LISA unique en Suisse et devenez spécialiste du travail sous tension dans le réseau à moyenne tension. Ensemble, nous assurons une alimentation électrique sûre – avec responsabilité, technologie de pointe et un esprit d'équipe fort.

## Vos tâches
• Vous effectuerez des travaux sur des lignes aériennes à moyenne tension dans le cadre de projets d'expansion, de maintenance et de maintenance
• Avec l'équipe, vous créez, renouvellez et rénovez des systèmes de lignes aériennes et contribuez à un approvisionnement énergétique fiable
• Après votre formation spéciale, vous prenez le travail sous tension sur les systèmes à moyenne tension et utilisez vos connaissances spécialisées spécifiquement
• En cas de perturbation, vous supportez un correctif rapide et vous aidez activement à assurer une grande disponibilité du réseau
• Vous travaillez dans les circuits ainsi que dans les coupures de courant et les mises en service et utilisez en toute sécurité des véhicules, des ascenseurs et des équipements spéciaux
• Vous appliquez systématiquement des normes de sécurité et de qualité et contribuez à une culture de travail dans laquelle le soutien mutuel est une question bien sûr

• Vous voulez développer un spécialiste pour travailler sous tension moyenne tension et apporter la volonté nécessaire pour apprendre
• Idéalement, vous pourriez déjà acquérir de l'expérience dans la construction ou l'entretien de lignes aériennes à moyenne tension
• Un travail indépendant, fiable et soucieux de sécurité vous distingue ainsi qu'une utilisation responsable de l'infrastructure et des matériaux
• Travailler en plein air et en hauteur vous donne plaisir et vous apportez la flexibilité ainsi que la préparation pour des missions variées
• Vous avez le permis de conduire de catégorie B, un permis de catégorie BE ou C est avantageux

## Become part of the energy future and expand your skills
Training as a grid electrician:in opens up new perspectives for Stromer:innen in times of energy transition and digitalization. Here you can expand your skills and develop professionally.

## Your tasks
• You build, operate and maintain the distribution network of BKW together with your colleagues
• You carry out assembly work and are responsible for the maintenance and troubleshooting of our plants in the low and medium voltage distribution network
• You lay cable lines, maintain overhead lines and are also there when it comes to repairing damage

## You bring that with you
• Completed vocational training as an electrical installer:in EFZ, or assembly electrician:in EFZ
• You bring experience with electrical installations and are ready to take care of piquet and interference services
• Team cohesion, mutual trust and secure working is just as important to you as your future work colleagues:
• We generously support your desire for professional development
• You have a category B or C driving licence
• Good knowledge of German, every other language is an additional plus
Become part of our team and discover your opportunities. Further information about the lateral entry can be found here.
We do not want requests from personnel service providers.
• Company BKW Energie AG
• Place of work Viktoriaplatz 2, 3013 Bern
• Pensum 60-100 %
• Cross-entry possible
• Professional field network
• Type of employment Contract of unlimited duration
• Reference S-23474

## You can look forward to that.
meaningful activity We make a valuable contribution to society and the environment. Together we create living spaces with a future in which people like to live.
We compensate on the market and offer attractive social and salary benefits. The remuneration is based on the function and relevant experience.
Working hours & holidays With our flexible working models, our employees can combine work and leisure well. For example, with annual working hours, remote working or unpaid leave.
Career & further education With us many doors are open. We promote specialist and management careers equally and focus on tailor-made training and further education opportunities.
With various childcare services, family allowances and company social counselling, we promote the compatibility of work and family.
Occupational Safety and Health With comprehensive services, we support our employees in maintaining and increasing their physical health and mental fitness.
From staff restaurants to third-party perks, we offer our employees a number of other benefits.
For individual positions (e.g. temporary employment), different employment conditions may apply.
Place of work

## About us
BKW offers its customers internationally complete solutions in the fields of energy, buildings and infrastructure. We employ around 11,500 people. Together we build networks, produce energy, plan and realise energy-efficient buildings and design sustainable living spaces of tomorrow.
For this we need you: people with ideas and commitment. Make a valuable contribution to society and our environment with us!
Discover more
We live in the BKW Group a welcome culture that includes all people. We welcome everyone, regardless of factors such as age, gender, social or ethnic origin, skin colour, nationality, language, sexual orientation and identity or religion.

## Apprenticeship start August 2027, earlier employment possible (two-simmen)
Are you tired of your current job and want to reorient yourself? Do you want to work outside and a job with a future? As a grid electrician: in you actively shape the energy supply. You can expect team spirit, interesting construction sites and financial security during training.

## Your tasks
As a future grid electrician, you will take on a versatile and varied area of responsibility. From your base, you and the team actively contribute to the electricity flowing into the households. You build, operate and maintain our facilities in the region and carry out assembly work in the low or medium voltage network. You help connect a newly built building to the distribution grid and ensure the correct wiring at a transformer station. You work with different materials such as wood or metal, perform work on the ground or in height and operate larger and smaller machines and vehicles.

## You bring that with you
• You are ready to complete the two- or three-year apprenticeship as a grid electrician: in EFZ
• You want to reorient yourself and are motivated in a team from the beginning
• You like working outside and don’t shy away from working at altitude
• Your team can always rely on you
• Ideally, you have a category B driving licence
We do not want requests from personnel service providers.

• Place of work Moosbachweg 2, 3770 Zweisimmen
• Pensum 100
• Cross-entry possible
• Professional field network

• Reference S-27364

## You can look forward to it.
meaningful activity We make a valuable contribution to society and the environment. Together we create living spaces with a future in which people like to live.
We compensate on the market and offer attractive social and salary benefits. The remuneration is based on the function and the relevant experience.
Working hours & holidays With our flexible working models, our employees can combine work and leisure time well. For example, with annual working hours, remote working or unpaid leave.
Career & further education With us many doors are open. We promote specialist and management careers equally and focus on tailor-made training and further education opportunities.
With various childcare services, family allowances and company social counselling, we promote the compatibility of work and family.
Occupational Safety and Health With comprehensive services, we support our employees in maintaining and increasing their physical health and mental fitness.
From staff restaurants to third-party perks, we offer our employees a number of other benefits.
For individual positions (e.g. temporary employment), different employment conditions may apply.
Place of work

## About us
BKW offers its customers internationally complete solutions in the fields of energy, buildings and infrastructure. We employ around 11,500 people. Together we build networks, produce energy, plan and realise energy-efficient buildings and design sustainable living spaces of tomorrow.
For this we need you: people with ideas and commitment. Make a valuable contribution to society and our environment with us!
Discover more
In the BKW Group we live a welcome culture that includes all people. We welcome everyone, regardless of factors such as age, gender, social or ethnic origin, colour, nationality, language, sexual orientation and identity or religion.

## Inizio dell'insegnamento agosto 2027 (Gstaad)
Gli elettricisti a griglia BKW assicurano la costruzione, il funzionamento e la manutenzione della rete elettrica. Attendere con ansia le sfide emozionanti e un team consolidato che vi accompagnerà nel vostro cammino per diventare uno specialista.

## I tuoi compiti
In qualità di specialista per tutti i lavori sulla rete elettrica, si è responsabili per la costruzione, il funzionamento e la manutenzione di cavi e linee aeree, stazioni di commutazione e trasformatori e illuminazione pubblica. Sia in città che in campagna, siete quasi tutti i giorni sulla strada e all'aperto - in estate e in inverno. Scoprirai così tutto il mondo dell'energia elettrica e potrai rompere con coraggio il nuovo terreno. Per ridurre al minimo i rischi nel tuo lavoro impegnativo, impari a utilizzare strumenti e macchine in modo sicuro.
Sia nella trincea del cavo o sui masti della linea sopraelevata: Come elettricista della griglia, di solito lavori nel gruppo. È necessaria una buona cooperazione e una reciproca fiducia.

## Start of teaching August 2027 (Gstaad)
Grid electricians at BKW ensure the construction, operation and maintenance of the power grid. Look forward to exciting challenges and a well-established team that will accompany you on your way to becoming a specialist.

## Your tasks
As a specialist for all work on the power grid, you are responsible for the construction, operation and maintenance of cable and overhead lines, switch and transformer stations and public lighting. Whether in the city or in the countryside, you are almost daily on the road and outdoors - in summer and winter. You will thus discover the whole world of electrical energy and can courageously break new ground. Despite technical aids, you often put on your own hand and find a way to solve the problems independently. In order to minimize risks in your challenging job, you learn how to use tools and machines safely.
Be it in the cable trench or on the overhead line masts: As a grid electrician, you usually work in the group. Good cooperation and mutual trust are needed.

## You bring that with you
• Real or secondary degree with good mathematical skills
• Good technical understanding and German level of mind. B2 at start of teaching
• Joy of craftsmanship and outdoor activities
• Reliable and cheerful on the road in a team

## Début de l'enseignement août 2027 (Gstaad)
Les électriciens de BKW assurent la construction, l'exploitation et l'entretien du réseau électrique. Réjouissez-vous de défis passionnants et d'une équipe bien établie qui vous accompagnera sur votre chemin pour devenir un spécialiste.

## Vos tâches
En tant que spécialiste de tous les travaux sur le réseau électrique, vous êtes responsable de la construction, de l'exploitation et de l'entretien des câbles et des lignes aériennes, des postes de commutation et de transformateur et de l'éclairage public. Que ce soit en ville ou à la campagne, vous êtes presque tous les jours sur la route et en plein air - en été et en hiver. Vous découvrirez ainsi le monde entier de l'énergie électrique et pourrez courageusement briser de nouveaux terrains. ## Apprendistato inizio agosto 2027, ex occupazione possibile (Wilderswil)
Sei stanco del tuo lavoro attuale e vuoi riorientarti? Vuoi lavorare fuori e lavorare con un futuro? Come elettricista della griglia: in voi formate attivamente l'approvvigionamento energetico. Ci si può aspettare spirito di squadra, interessanti cantieri e sicurezza finanziaria durante la formazione.

## I tuoi compiti
Come futuro elettricista della griglia, si assumerà un'area versatile e variegata di responsabilità. Dalla vostra base, voi e il team contribuite attivamente all'elettricità che scorre nelle famiglie. Costruire, operare e mantenere le nostre strutture nella regione e svolgere lavori di montaggio nella rete a bassa o media tensione. Aiuta a collegare un edificio di nuova costruzione alla rete di distribuzione e garantire il corretto cablaggio in una stazione di trasformatore. Lavorare con materiali diversi come legno o metallo, eseguire lavori a terra o in altezza e utilizzare macchine e veicoli più grandi e piccoli.

## Lo porti con te.
• Siete pronti a completare l'apprendistato di due o tre anni come elettricista della griglia: in EFZ

Non vogliamo richieste da fornitori di servizi di personale.

attività significativa Facciamo un prezioso contributo alla società e all'ambiente. Insieme creiamo spazi vivi con un futuro in cui le persone amano vivere.
Complimentiamo sul mercato e offriamo benefici sociali e salariali attraenti. La remunerazione si basa sulla funzione e sulla relativa esperienza.

Con vari servizi di assistenza all'infanzia, assegni familiari e consulenza sociale aziendale, promuoviamo la compatibilità del lavoro e della famiglia.

## Su di noi
BKW offre ai propri clienti soluzioni complete a livello internazionale nel campo dell'energia, degli edifici e delle infrastrutture. Usiamo circa 11.500 persone. Insieme costruiamo reti, produciamo energia, progettiamo e realizziamo edifici a basso consumo energetico e progettiamo spazi abitativi sostenibili di domani.
Per questo abbiamo bisogno di voi: persone con idee e impegno. Fai un prezioso contributo alla società e al nostro ambiente con noi!

Nel Gruppo BKW viviamo una cultura di benvenuto che comprende tutte le persone. Accogliamo tutti, indipendentemente da fattori quali età, genere, origine sociale o etnica, colore, nazionalità, lingua, orientamento sessuale e identità o religione.

## Apprenticeship start August 2027, former employment possible (Wilderswil)
Are you tired of your current job and want to reorient yourself? Do you want to work outside and a job with a future? As a grid electrician: in you actively shape the energy supply. You can expect team spirit, interesting construction sites and financial security during training.

## Your tasks
As a future grid electrician, you will take on a versatile and varied area of responsibility. From your base, you and the team actively contribute to the electricity flowing into the households. You build, operate and maintain our facilities in the region and carry out assembly work in the low or medium voltage network. You help connect a newly built building to the distribution grid and ensure the correct wiring at a transformer station. You work with different materials such as wood or metal, perform work on the ground or in height and operate larger and smaller machines and vehicles.

## You bring that with you
• You are ready to complete the two- or three-year apprenticeship as a grid electrician: in EFZ
• You want to reorient yourself and are motivated in a team from the beginning
• You like working outside and don’t shy away from working at altitude
• Your team can always rely on you
• Ideally, you have a category B driving licence
We do not want requests from personnel service providers.
• Company BKW Energie AG
• Location Wengelacherweg 18, 3812 Wilderswil
• Pensum 100
• Cross-entry possible
• Professional field network
• Type of employment Training, apprenticeship
• Reference S-27365

## You can look forward to it.
meaningful activity We make a valuable contribution to society and the environment. Together we create living spaces with a future in which people like to live.
We compensate on the market and offer attractive social and salary benefits. The remuneration is based on the function and the relevant experience.
Working hours & holidays With our flexible working models, our employees can combine work and leisure time well. For example, with annual working hours, remote working or unpaid leave.
Career & further education With us many doors are open. We promote specialist and management careers equally and focus on tailor-made training and further education opportunities.
With various childcare services, family allowances and company social counselling, we promote the compatibility of work and family.
Occupational Safety and Health With comprehensive services, we support our employees in maintaining and increasing their physical health and mental fitness.
From staff restaurants to third-party perks, we offer our employees a number of other benefits.
For individual positions (e.g. temporary employment), different employment conditions may apply.
Place of work

## About us
BKW offers its customers internationally complete solutions in the fields of energy, buildings and infrastructure. We employ around 11,500 people. Together we build networks, produce energy, plan and realise energy-efficient buildings and design sustainable living spaces of tomorrow.
For this we need you: people with ideas and commitment. Make a valuable contribution to society and our environment with us!
Discover more
In the BKW Group we live a welcome culture that includes all people. We welcome everyone, regardless of factors such as age, gender, social or ethnic origin, colour, nationality, language, sexual orientation and identity or religion.

## Lehrstart August 2027 (Zweisimmen)
Netzelektrikerinnen und Netzelektriker bei der BKW sorgen für den Bau, Betrieb und Unterhalt des Stromnetzes. Freue dich auf spannende Herausforderungen und ein eingespieltes Team, das dich auf deinem Weg zur Fachperson begleitet.

## Deine Aufgaben
Als Spezialistin oder Spezialist für alle Arbeiten am Stromnetz bist du für den Bau, Betrieb und Unterhalt von Kabel- und Freileitungen, von Schalt- und Transformatorenstationen sowie für öffentliche Beleuchtungen zuständig. Ob in der Stadt oder auf dem Land, du bist fast täglich unterwegs und im Freien tätig - im Sommer sowie im Winter. Du entdeckst somit die ganze Welt der elektrischen Energie und kannst mit Mut neue Wege gehen. Trotz technischer Hilfsmittel legst du auch oft selber Hand an und findest selbstständig einen Weg, die Probleme zu lösen. Um Risiken in deiner herausfordernden Tätigkeit zu minimieren, lernst du den sicheren Umgang mit Werkzeugen und Maschinen.
Sei es im Kabelgraben oder auf den Freileitungsmasten: Als Netzelektrikerin oder Netzelektriker arbeitest du meistens in der Gruppe. Da ist gute Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gefragt.

• Real- oder Sekundarschlabschluss mit guten mathematischen Fähigkeiten
• Gutes technisches Verständnis und Deutschniveau von mind. B2 bei Lehrbeginn
• Freude an handwerklicher Arbeit und Tätigkeiten im Freien

In qualità di specialista per tutti i lavori sulla rete elettrica, si è responsabili per la costruzione, il funzionamento e la manutenzione di cavi e linee aeree, stazioni di commutazione e trasformatori e illuminazione pubblica. Sia in città che in campagna, siete quasi tutti i giorni sulla strada e all'aperto - in estate e in inverno. Scoprirai così tutto il mondo dell'energia elettrica e potrai rompere con coraggio il nuovo terreno. Nonostante gli aiuti tecnici, spesso si mette in mano e trovare un modo per risolvere i problemi indipendentemente. Per ridurre al minimo i rischi nel tuo lavoro impegnativo, impari a utilizzare strumenti e macchine in modo sicuro.
Sia nella trincea del cavo o sui masti della linea sopraelevata: Come elettricista della griglia, di solito lavori nel gruppo. È necessaria una buona cooperazione e una reciproca fiducia.

• Gioia dell'artigianato e delle attività all'aperto

## Start of teaching August 2027 (Zweisimmen)
Grid electricians at BKW ensure the construction, operation and maintenance of the power grid. Look forward to exciting challenges and a well-established team that will accompany you on your way to becoming a specialist.

## Your tasks
As a specialist for all work on the power grid, you are responsible for the construction, operation and maintenance of cable and overhead lines, switch and transformer stations and public lighting. Whether in the city or in the countryside, you are almost daily on the road and outdoors - in summer and winter. You will thus discover the whole world of electrical energy and can courageously break new ground. Despite technical aids, you often put on your own hand and find a way to solve the problems independently. In order to minimize risks in your challenging job, you learn how to use tools and machines safely.
Be it in the cable trench or on the overhead line masts: As a grid electrician, you usually work in the group. Good cooperation and mutual trust are needed.

## You bring that with you
• Real or secondary degree with good mathematical skills
• Good technical understanding and German level of mind. B2 at start of teaching
• Joy of craftsmanship and outdoor activities
• Reliable and cheerful on the road in a team

Do you want to accompany challenging projects in the field of heating and cooling systems from the idea to the realization? Then you are exactly right with us. Well located, near the station Stettbach, we offer you a modern workplace so that you can contribute your knowledge.

## Your tasks
• Support of the project team in exciting construction projects in the field of heating and cooling systems
• Independent implementation of planning services from concept development to planning and implementation
• Competent contact person for customers and the planning team in technical and economic matters
• As a link to the various trades in construction, you feel safe in dealing with and communicating with the project participants

• In the project planning and implementation of demanding heating and cooling systems, you can have several years of professional experience

We do not want requests from personnel service providers.

## You can look forward to that.
With us you plan with the latest digital technologies for innovative and sustainable construction projects. We create habitats with a future.
We offer you attractive social benefits and pay your daily allowance insurance as well as a private insurance in the event of an accident.

## About us
With over 160 engineers and specialists, Enerpeak AG is one of the leading complete service providers for building technology and energy. For this we need you: people with ideas and commitment. Make a valuable contribution to society and our environment with us!
Discover more
We live in the BKW Group a welcome culture that includes all people. We welcome everyone, regardless of factors such as age, gender, social or ethnic origin, skin colour, nationality, language, sexual orientation and identity or religion.

jobs.title: Netzelektriker:in Netzbau (alle)
jobs.description:
Vom Standort Luterbach aus sorgst du gemeinsam mit deinem Team dafür, dass die Region zuverlässig mit Energie versorgt wird. Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche Einsätze im Netzbau und ein Arbeitsumfeld mit direktem Bezug zur Infrastruktur von morgen.

## Dein Wirkungsfeld
• Du baust, montierst und unterhältst Netzanlagen im Bereich 132–0,4 kV sowie Freileitungen
• Arbeiten an Stationen, Kabelanlagen und Netzanschlüssen führst du selbständig und im Team aus
• Manuelle Schaltungen vor Ort setzt du sicher um und meldest Netzunterbrüche korrekt weiter
• Spezialfahrzeuge und technische Hilfsmittel nutzt du verantwortungsvoll im Arbeitsalltag
• Ausgeführte Arbeiten dokumentierst du nachvollziehbar und unterstützt den Informationsfluss
• Kundenanliegen und Netzstörungen nimmst du auf und leitest diese an die zuständigen Stellen weiter

## Deine Stärken
• Du hast eine Ausbildung als Netzelektriker:in EFZ oder eine elektrotechnische Grundbildung abgeschlossen
• Erste Erfahrung im Netzbau oder in der Energieversorgung bringst du bereits mit
• Selbständiges und zuverlässiges Arbeiten gehört zu deiner täglichen Arbeitsweise
• Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Umweltvorgaben setzt du konsequent um
• Arbeiten im Freien sowie praktische Einsätze im Team machen dir Freude
• Du besitzt den Führerausweis Kategorie B
Bei BKW Power Grid gestalten wir eine zuverlässige Energiezukunft durch innovative Lösungen, Verantwortung und enge Zusammenarbeit. Vielfalt ist dabei ein zentraler Erfolgsfaktor: Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Kompetenzen stärken unsere Teams und unsere Lösungen.
Erfahre hier mehr darüber, wie wir Vielfalt bei Power Grid leben.
Wir wünschen keine Anfragen von Personaldienstleistern.
• Firma BKW Energie AG
• Arbeitsort Jurastrasse 13, 4542 Luterbach
• Pensum 60-100%
• Berufsfeld Netz
• Anstellungsart Unbefristeter Vertrag
• Referenznummer S-27065

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen
Sinnvolle Tätigkeit Wir leisten einen wertvollen Beitrag für Gesellschaft und Umwelt. Gemeinsam gestalten wir Lebensräume mit Zukunft, in denen Menschen gerne leben.
Vergütung & Sozialleistungen Wir vergüten am Markt und bieten attraktive Sozial- sowie Salärnebenleistungen. Die Vergütung orientiert sich an der Funktion und der relevanten Erfahrung.
Arbeitszeit & Urlaub Mit unseren flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen können unsere Mitarbeitenden Beruf und Freizeit gut miteinander verbinden. Zum Beispiel mit Jahresarbeitszeit, Remote Working oder unbezahltem Urlaub.
Karriere & Weiterbildung Bei uns stehen viele Türen offen. Wir fördern Fach- und Führungslaufbahnen gleichermassen und setzen auf massgeschneiderte Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
Familie & Beruf Mit diversen Kinderbetreuungsangeboten, Familienzulagen sowie einer betrieblichen Sozialberatung fördern wir die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie.
Arbeitssicherheit & Gesundheit Mit umfassenden Dienstleistungen unterstützen wir unsere Mitarbeitenden im Erhalt und in der Steigerung ihrer körperlichen Gesundheit und geistigen Fitness.
Weitere Vorteile Von Personalrestaurant bis zu Vergünstigungen bei Drittfirmen - wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden eine Reihe von weiteren Vorteilen.
Für einzelne Stellen (z.B. befristete Anstellungen) können abweichende Anstellungsbedingungen gelten.
Arbeitsort

## Über uns

jobs.title: Fachspezialist:in Sekundärtechnik (alle)
jobs.description:
Du möchtest an wichtigen Anlagen unseres Stromnetzes arbeiten und Verantwortung übernehmen? In dieser vielseitigen Funktion bringst du Schutz-, Steuer- und Leittechnik zuverlässig zum Laufen – in Unterwerken, Trafostationen und Kraftwerken.

## Deine Aufgaben
• Du leitest Baustellen in Hochspannungsanlagen der BKW sowie bei externen Kund:innen und stellst dabei die Arbeitssicherheit sicher
• Primär- und Sekundäranlagen nimmst du selbständig in Betrieb – von der Steuerungs-, Leit- und Schutztechnik bis zu Transformatoren und Schaltanlagen
• Instandhaltungs- und Servicearbeiten an Schutzsystemen und weiteren Komponenten der Sekundärtechnik führst du sorgfältig aus
• An Bausitzungen stimmst du dich mit internen Fachstellen, Projektbeteiligten und Kund:innen ab
• Prüf- und Inbetriebnahmedokumentationen erstellst und kontrollierst du zuverlässig
• Nach einer umfassenden Einarbeitung beteiligst du dich während rund vier Wochen pro Jahr am Bereitschaftsdienst

## Das bringst du mit
• Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene elektrotechnische Grundbildung, beispielsweise als Automatiker:in EFZ oder Elektroinstallateur:in EFZ
• Eine Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF oder FH in Elektro- oder Systemtechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

## Se rapprocher davantage – aussi à temps partiel et dans le partage de l'emploi
Chez BKW Power Grid, nous promouvons l'égalité des chances, l'inclusion et les formes flexibles de travail. Dans un environnement respectueux, vous façonnez l'avenir énergétique avec nous d'une manière engagée, commune et tournée vers l'avenir.

## Vos tâches
• Vous êtes responsable et évaluez les demandes de suivi technique, y compris le calcul des mesures nécessaires dans le processus de rapport
• L'inspection officielle, la collecte et le contrôle des présentoirs d'installation et des preuves de sécurité sont au cœur de votre travail.
• Vous traitez les commandes de machines, enregistrez les commandes pour l'assemblage des compteurs et assurez un processus en douceur
• Vous évaluez les demandes d'installation technique avec compétence et planifiez les mesures nécessaires pour une mise en œuvre sûre et efficace
• Vous coordonnez les commandes entre les points de contact internes et externes et êtes le point de contact pour les informations techniques.
• Vous participez activement à l'amélioration, au développement et à la numérisation de nos processus et apportez vos idées

## Apporte ça avec toi.
• Formation professionnelle complétée en tant qu'installateur électrique:dans EFZ, installateur électrique:dans EFZ, électricien de réseau:dans EFZ ou une qualification électrotechnique comparable
• Dans l'idéal, vous avez déjà une formation complémentaire dans le secteur électrotechnique, par exemple en tant que consultant en sécurité: en, chef de projet électrique: en ou technicien: en HF
• Bonne connaissance des processus de connexion et de rapport conformément à la NIV, aux règlements de travail et aux normes et règlements pertinents
• Un moyen structuré et précis de travailler avec plaisir à l'examen approfondi des questions et à la satisfaction des besoins
• Le traitement responsable des données, des processus et des préoccupations des clients vous distingue
• Vous apportez de très bonnes compétences en allemand ou en français dans la parole et l'écriture ainsi que des connaissances avancées de l'autre langue
Nous ne voulons pas de demandes de fournisseurs de services au personnel.

• Pensum 50-100 %
• Un travail à distance est possible
• Partage de l'emploi possible
• Réseau professionnel sur le terrain

## Vous pouvez attendre avec impatience.
une activité significative Nous apportons une contribution précieuse à la société et à l'environnement. Ensemble, nous créons des espaces de vie avec un avenir dans lequel les gens aiment vivre.
Nous compensons sur le marché et offrons des avantages sociaux et salariaux attrayants. La rémunération est basée sur la fonction et l'expérience pertinente.
Heures de travail et jours fériés Avec nos modèles de travail flexibles, nos employés peuvent bien combiner le travail et les loisirs. Par exemple, avec des heures de travail annuelles, des congés de travail à distance ou des congés non rémunérés.
Carrière & formation continue Avec nous, de nombreuses portes sont ouvertes. Nous promouvons les carrières de spécialiste et de gestionnaire sur un pied d'égalité et nous nous concentrons sur la formation sur mesure et les possibilités de formation continue.
Avec divers services de garde d'enfants, allocations familiales et conseils sociaux d'entreprise, nous favorisons la compatibilité entre le travail et la famille.
Sécurité et santé au travail Grâce à des services complets, nous aidons nos employés à maintenir et à améliorer leur santé physique et leur condition mentale.
Des restaurants du personnel aux avantages de tiers, nous offrons à nos employés un certain nombre d'autres avantages.
Pour les postes individuels (p. ex. emploi temporaire), des conditions d'emploi différentes peuvent s'appliquer.
Lieu de travail

## Sur nous
BKW propose à ses clients des solutions internationales complètes dans les domaines de l'énergie, des bâtiments et des infrastructures. Nous employons environ 11 500 personnes. Ensemble, nous construisons des réseaux, produisons de l'énergie, planifions et réalisons des bâtiments économes en énergie et concevons des espaces de vie durables de demain.
Pour cela nous avons besoin de vous : des personnes avec des idées et de l'engagement. Faites une contribution précieuse à la société et à notre environnement avec nous!
En savoir plus
Nous vivons dans le groupe BKW une culture d'accueil qui inclut toutes les personnes. Nous accueillons tous, quels que soient les facteurs tels que l'âge, le sexe, l'origine sociale ou ethnique, la couleur de la peau, la nationalité, la langue, l'orientation sexuelle et l'identité ou la religion.

## Lehrstart August 2027
Informatikerinnen oder Informatiker bei der BKW sorgen dafür, dass die IT-Infrastruktur stets funktioniert und auf dem neusten Stand der Technik ist. Bei der BKW profitierst du von einer umfassenden, praxisnahen Ausbildung und wirst zu einer gefragten IT-Fachperson in der Plattformentwicklung.

## Deine Aufgaben
• In der Plattformentwicklung bist du zuständig für den fachgerechten Aufbau und die regelmässige Wartung von Informatiksystemen.
• Du konfigurierst und überprüfst Dienste wie Freigaben und Datensicherung.
• Ausserdem bist du zuständig für die Sicherheit der Netzwerke und behebst kompetent Störungen. Dazu lernst du schrittweise die Geräte und Applikationen, die in der BKW benutzt werden, genau kennen.
• Als Lernende oder Lernender startest du deine Lehre mit einem abwechslungsreichen Basislehrjahr im Berufsbildungscenter Bern (Bbc). Anschliessend erweiterst und vertiefst du deine Kompetenzen im Betrieb.
• Dank verschiedenen Praktika entdeckst du verschiedene Bereiche der IT und kannst selbst in Projekten mitwirken.

## Das bringst du mit
• Du bist in der 9. Klasse (Sekundarniveau) oder befindest dich im 10. Schuljahr.
• Mathematik (gute Noten) und Computer interessieren dich und du bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit.
• Logisches Denken und eine gute Kombinationsgabe fallen dir leicht und du bringst die notwendige Geduld und Kreativität für die Lösung von komplexen Aufgaben mit.
• Du arbeitest mit System und hast eine hervorragende Konzentrationsfähigkeit.
• Du hast ein gutes räumliches und abstraktes Vorstellungsvermögen.
• Abwechslung zwischen selbstständigem Arbeiten und Teamarbeit findest du gut.
Ein Eignungstest (z.B. Multicheck) ist erwünscht.

Combina la profondità quantitativa con la comprensione pratica del mercato e sviluppa modelli di rischio e valutazione robusti per il trading, le attività e i temi di rischio a livello di gruppo nell'ambiente dinamico dell'energia e delle materie prime.

## Il tuo campo di attività
• Svilupperai modelli di rischio e valutazione quantitativa per portafogli di asset, trading e vendite e temi di rischio a livello di gruppo.
• La modellazione di energia elettrica, gas e altri mercati delle materie prime, nonché l'ulteriore sviluppo di modelli di valutazione e di rischio stocastici fanno parte della vostra area centrale di responsabilità.
• Calibrazioni regolari, test e benchmarking sono garantiti per quanto riguarda la qualità del modello, la trasparenza e la tracciabilità
• Assieme alle funzioni di trading, di origine, di analisi e di altre funzioni di rischio, lavorerai su metodi di valutazione e di rischio basati sul mercato per posizioni di mercato complesse.
• Preparare informazioni quantitative per comitati di rischio, comitati di gestione e altri stakeholder
• La costruzione di soluzioni di modellazione, dati e reporting scalabili e manutenbili supporta l'ulteriore sviluppo del nostro ambiente tecnologico

## Lo porti con te.
• Diversi anni di esperienza nella modellazione quantitativa, nella gestione del rischio o nel commercio di materie prime nell'ambiente energetico costituiscono la base per il vostro contributo professionale
• Hai sviluppato, implementato e sviluppato i modelli di rischio, prezzi o valutazione in un ambiente di mercato con elevate dinamiche
• Le relazioni complesse nei mercati dell'energia e delle materie prime possono essere analizzate in modo strutturato e comprensibile
• Conoscenza molto buona di Python, SQL e moderni metodi di lavoro analitico ti aiutano a implementare soluzioni quantitative in modo efficiente e comprensibile
• Si avvicinano i cambiamenti di tecnologie, processi o metodi di lavoro apertamente e pragmaticamente avanzare argomenti quantitativi
• Lo scambio con diverse aree specialistiche è facile per voi e vi muovete in modo sicuro tra domande tecniche e prospettive di business
Non vogliamo richieste da fornitori di servizi di personale.

attività significativa Facciamo un prezioso contributo alla società e all'ambiente. Insieme creiamo spazi vivi con un futuro in cui le persone amano vivere.

## Su di noi
BKW offre soluzioni globali all'avanguardia nei settori dell'energia, degli edifici e delle infrastrutture – a livello internazionale e in collaborazione. Con circa 12.000 dipendenti, costruiamo reti moderne, generiamo energia rinnovabile e realizziamo edifici ad alta efficienza energetica. Per questo cerchiamo persone con passione, che insieme a noi danno un contributo alla società e all'ambiente di domani. Diventa parte della rete BKW e crea spazi abitativi con noi!

descriptionByLocale.en:
You combine quantitative depth with practical market understanding and develop robust risk and valuation models for trading, assets and group-wide risk topics in the dynamic energy and commodity environment.

## Your field of activity
• You will develop quantitative risk and valuation models for asset, trading and sales portfolios as well as group-wide risk topics.
• The modeling of electricity, gas and other commodity markets as well as the further development of stochastic valuation and risk models are part of your central area of responsibility.
• Regular calibrations, backtesting and benchmarking are ensured with regard to model quality, transparency and traceability
• Together with trading, origination, analysis functions and other risk functions, you will work on market-based valuation and risk approaches for complex market positions.
• Prepare quantitative insights for risk committees, management committees and other stakeholders
• Building scalable and maintainable modeling, data and reporting solutions supports the further development of our technological environment

## You bring that with you
• Several years of experience in quantitative modeling, risk management or commodity trading in the energy environment form the basis for your professional contribution
• You have developed, implemented and developed risk, pricing or valuation models yourself in a market environment with high dynamics
• Complex relationships in energy and commodity markets can be analyzed in a structured and understandable way
• Very good knowledge of Python, SQL and modern analytical working methods help you to implement quantitative solutions efficiently and comprehensibly
• You approach changes in technologies, processes or working methods openly and pragmatically advance quantitative topics
• The exchange with different specialist areas is easy for you and you move safely between technical questions and business perspectives
We do not want requests from personnel service providers.

meaningful activity We make a valuable contribution to society and the environment. Together we create living spaces with a future in which people like to live.

## Votre domaine d'activité
• Vous développerez des modèles quantitatifs de risque et d'évaluation pour les portefeuilles d'actifs, de négociation et de vente ainsi que des sujets de risque à l'échelle du groupe.
• La modélisation des marchés de l'électricité, du gaz et d'autres produits de base ainsi que le développement de modèles d'évaluation et de risque stochastiques font partie de votre domaine de responsabilité central.
• Des étalonnages réguliers, des contre-essais et des analyses comparatives sont assurés en ce qui concerne la qualité, la transparence et la traçabilité des modèles.
• En plus des fonctions de négociation, d'origine, d'analyse et d'autres fonctions de risque, vous travaillerez sur des approches d'évaluation et de risque basées sur le marché pour des positions de marché complexes.
• Préparer des perspectives quantitatives pour les comités de risque, les comités de gestion et les autres intervenants
• Bâtir des solutions de modélisation, de données et de rapports évolutives et durables favorise le développement de notre environnement technologique

## Apporte ça avec toi.
• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans la modélisation quantitative, la gestion des risques ou le commerce des matières premières dans l'environnement énergétique constituent la base de votre contribution professionnelle
• Vous avez développé, mis en œuvre et développé des modèles de risque, de tarification ou d'évaluation vous-même dans un environnement de marché à forte dynamique
• Les relations complexes sur les marchés de l'énergie et des produits de base peuvent être analysées de manière structurée et compréhensible.
• Très bonne connaissance de Python, SQL et méthodes de travail analytiques modernes vous aident à mettre en œuvre des solutions quantitatives de manière efficace et compréhensible

## Lehrstart August 2027 (Emmenmatt)
Netzelektrikerinnen und Netzelektriker bei der BKW sorgen für den Bau, Betrieb und Unterhalt des Stromnetzes. Freue dich auf spannende Herausforderungen und ein eingespieltes Team, das dich auf deinem Weg zur Fachperson begleitet.

Die BKW bietet ihren Kundinnen und Kunden international Gesamtlösungen in den Bereichen Energie, Gebäude und Infrastruktur an. Wir beschäftigen rund 11'500 Mitarbeitende. ## Inizio dell'insegnamento agosto 2027 (Emmenmatt)
Gli elettricisti a griglia BKW assicurano la costruzione, il funzionamento e la manutenzione della rete elettrica. Attendere con ansia le sfide emozionanti e un team consolidato che vi accompagnerà nel vostro cammino per diventare uno specialista.

## I tuoi compiti
In qualità di specialista per tutti i lavori sulla rete elettrica, si è responsabili per la costruzione, il funzionamento e la manutenzione di cavi e linee aeree, stazioni di commutazione e trasformatori e illuminazione pubblica. Sia in città che in campagna, siete quasi tutti i giorni sulla strada e all'aperto - in estate e in inverno. Scoprirai così tutto il mondo dell'energia elettrica e potrai rompere con coraggio il nuovo terreno. Nonostante gli aiuti tecnici, spesso si mette in mano e trovare un modo per risolvere i problemi indipendentemente. Per ridurre al minimo i rischi nel tuo lavoro impegnativo, impari a utilizzare strumenti e macchine in modo sicuro.
Sia nella trincea del cavo o sui masti della linea sopraelevata: Come elettricista della griglia, di solito lavori nel gruppo. È necessaria una buona cooperazione e una reciproca fiducia.

## Lo porti con te.
• Laurea reale o secondaria con buone abilità matematiche
• Buona comprensione tecnica e livello di mente tedesco. B2 all'inizio dell'insegnamento
• Gioia dell'artigianato e delle attività all'aperto
• Affidabile e allegro sulla strada in una squadra
• Società BKW Energie AG

attività significativa Facciamo un prezioso contributo alla società e all'ambiente. Insieme creiamo spazi vivi con un futuro in cui le persone amano vivere.
Complimentiamo sul mercato e offriamo benefici sociali e salariali attraenti. La remunerazione si basa sulla funzione e sulla relativa esperienza.

Con vari servizi di assistenza all'infanzia, assegni familiari e consulenza sociale aziendale, promuoviamo la compatibilità del lavoro e della famiglia.

Dai ristoranti del personale ai perks di terze parti, offriamo ai nostri dipendenti una serie di altri vantaggi.
Per le posizioni individuali (ad esempio l'occupazione temporanea), possono essere applicate diverse condizioni di lavoro.
Luogo di lavoro

## Su di noi
BKW offre ai propri clienti soluzioni complete a livello internazionale nel campo dell'energia, degli edifici e delle infrastrutture. Usiamo circa 11.500 persone. Insieme costruiamo reti, produciamo energia, progettiamo e realizziamo edifici a basso consumo energetico e progettiamo spazi abitativi sostenibili di domani.
Per questo abbiamo bisogno di voi: persone con idee e impegno. Fai un prezioso contributo alla società e al nostro ambiente con noi!

Nel Gruppo BKW viviamo una cultura di benvenuto che comprende tutte le persone. Accogliamo tutti, indipendentemente da fattori quali età, genere, origine sociale o etnica, colore, nazionalità, lingua, orientamento sessuale e identità o religione.

## Start of teaching August 2027 (Emmenmatt)
Grid electricians at BKW ensure the construction, operation and maintenance of the power grid. Look forward to exciting challenges and a well-established team that will accompany you on your way to becoming a specialist.

## Your tasks
As a specialist for all work on the power grid, you are responsible for the construction, operation and maintenance of cable and overhead lines, switch and transformer stations and public lighting. Whether in the city or in the countryside, you are almost daily on the road and outdoors - in summer and winter. You will thus discover the whole world of electrical energy and can courageously break new ground. Despite technical aids, you often put on your own hand and find a way to solve the problems independently. In order to minimize risks in your challenging job, you learn how to use tools and machines safely.
Be it in the cable trench or on the overhead line masts: As a grid electrician, you usually work in the group. Good cooperation and mutual trust are needed.

## You bring that with you
• Real or secondary degree with good mathematical skills
• Good technical understanding and German level of mind. B2 at start of teaching
• Joy of craftsmanship and outdoor activities
• Reliable and cheerful on the road in a team
• Company BKW Energie AG

• Pensum 100
• Cross-entry possible

## You can look forward to it.
meaningful activity We make a valuable contribution to society and the environment. Together we create living spaces with a future in which people like to live.
We compensate on the market and offer attractive social and salary benefits. The remuneration is based on the function and the relevant experience.
Working hours & holidays With our flexible working models, our employees can combine work and leisure time well. For example, with annual working hours, remote working or unpaid leave.
Career & further education With us many doors are open. We promote specialist and management careers equally and focus on tailor-made training and further education opportunities.
With various childcare services, family allowances and company social counselling, we promote the compatibility of work and family.
Occupational Safety and Health With comprehensive services, we support our employees in maintaining and increasing their physical health and mental fitness.
From staff restaurants to third-party perks, we offer our employees a number of other benefits.
For individual positions (e.g. temporary employment), different employment conditions may apply.
Place of work

## About us
BKW offers its customers internationally complete solutions in the fields of energy, buildings and infrastructure. We employ around 11,500 people. Together we build networks, produce energy, plan and realise energy-efficient buildings and design sustainable living spaces of tomorrow.
For this we need you: people with ideas and commitment. Make a valuable contribution to society and our environment with us!
Discover more
In the BKW Group we live a welcome culture that includes all people. We welcome everyone, regardless of factors such as age, gender, social or ethnic origin, colour, nationality, language, sexual orientation and identity or religion.

Are you tired of your current job and want to reorient yourself? Do you want to work outside and a job with a future? As a grid electrician: in you actively shape the energy supply. You can expect team spirit, interesting construction sites and financial security during training.

As a future grid electrician, you will take on a versatile and varied area of responsibility. From your base, you and the team actively contribute to the electricity flowing into the households. You build, operate and maintain our facilities in the region and carry out assembly work in the low or medium voltage network. You help connect a newly built building to the distribution grid and ensure the correct wiring at a transformer station. You work with different materials such as wood or metal, perform work on the ground or in height and operate larger and smaller machines and vehicles.

Neuer Standort, neuer Teamspirit: Im Wankdorf entsteht unser neuer Stützpunkt – dein Einsatzgebiet liegt im Berner Mittelland, wo du den Ausbau und die Instandhaltung der Netzinfrastruktur aktiv mitgestaltest.

• Du arbeitest aktiv am Aufbau des neuen Standorts im Wankdorf mit und gestaltest Abläufe im Netzbau mit

## Apprendistato inizio agosto 2027, possibile impiego precedente (Gstaad)
Sei stanco del tuo lavoro attuale e vuoi riorientarti? Vuoi lavorare fuori e lavorare con un futuro? Come elettricista della griglia: in voi formate attivamente l'approvvigionamento energetico. Ci si può aspettare spirito di squadra, interessanti cantieri e sicurezza finanziaria durante la formazione.

## I tuoi compiti
Come futuro elettricista della griglia, si assumerà un'area versatile e variegata di responsabilità. Dalla vostra base, voi e il team contribuite attivamente all'elettricità che scorre nelle famiglie. Costruire, operare e mantenere le nostre strutture nella regione e svolgere lavori di montaggio nella rete a bassa o media tensione. Aiuta a collegare un edificio di nuova costruzione alla rete di distribuzione e garantire il corretto cablaggio in una stazione di trasformatore. Lavorare con materiali diversi come legno o metallo, eseguire lavori a terra o in altezza e utilizzare macchine e veicoli più grandi e piccoli.

## Lo porti con te.

Non vogliamo richieste da fornitori di servizi di personale.

attività significativa Facciamo un prezioso contributo alla società e all'ambiente. Insieme creiamo spazi vivi con un futuro in cui le persone amano vivere.
Complimentiamo sul mercato e offriamo benefici sociali e salariali attraenti. La remunerazione si basa sulla funzione e sulla relativa esperienza.
Ore lavorative e vacanze Con i nostri modelli di lavoro flessibili, i nostri dipendenti possono combinare bene il lavoro e il tempo libero. Ad esempio, con orari di lavoro annuali, lavoro a distanza o congedo non pagato.
Carriera & ulteriore formazione Con noi molte porte sono aperte. Promuoviamo carriere specialistiche e gestionali allo stesso modo e ci concentriamo sulla formazione su misura e ulteriori opportunità di istruzione.
Con vari servizi di assistenza all'infanzia, assegni familiari e consulenza sociale aziendale, promuoviamo la compatibilità del lavoro e della famiglia.
Sicurezza e salute sul lavoro Con servizi completi, sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti nel mantenere e aumentare la loro salute fisica e fitness mentale.
Dai ristoranti del personale ai perks di terze parti, offriamo ai nostri dipendenti una serie di altri vantaggi.
Per le posizioni individuali (ad esempio l'occupazione temporanea), possono essere applicate diverse condizioni di lavoro.
Luogo di lavoro

## Su di noi
BKW offre ai propri clienti soluzioni complete a livello internazionale nel campo dell'energia, degli edifici e delle infrastrutture. Usiamo circa 11.500 persone. Insieme costruiamo reti, produciamo energia, progettiamo e realizziamo edifici a basso consumo energetico e progettiamo spazi abitativi sostenibili di domani.
Per questo abbiamo bisogno di voi: persone con idee e impegno. Fai un prezioso contributo alla società e al nostro ambiente con noi!

Nel Gruppo BKW viviamo una cultura di benvenuto che comprende tutte le persone. Accogliamo tutti, indipendentemente da fattori quali età, genere, origine sociale o etnica, colore, nazionalità, lingua, orientamento sessuale e identità o religione.

## Apprenticeship start August 2027, earlier employment possible (Gstaad)
Are you tired of your current job and want to reorient yourself? Do you want to work outside and a job with a future? As a grid electrician: in you actively shape the energy supply. You can expect team spirit, interesting construction sites and financial security during training.

## Your tasks
As a future grid electrician, you will take on a versatile and varied area of responsibility. From your base, you and the team actively contribute to the electricity flowing into the households. You build, operate and maintain our facilities in the region and carry out assembly work in the low or medium voltage network. You help connect a newly built building to the distribution grid and ensure the correct wiring at a transformer station. You work with different materials such as wood or metal, perform work on the ground or in height and operate larger and smaller machines and vehicles.

## You bring that with you
• You are ready to complete the two- or three-year apprenticeship as a grid electrician: in EFZ
• You want to reorient yourself and are motivated in a team from the beginning
• You like working outside and don’t shy away from working at altitude
• Your team can always rely on you
• Ideally, you have a category B driving licence
We do not want requests from personnel service providers.
• Company BKW Energie AG
• Location Lauenenstrasse 50, 3780 Saanen
• Pensum 100
• Cross-entry possible
• Professional field network
• Type of employment Training, apprenticeship
• Reference S-27361

## You can look forward to it.
meaningful activity We make a valuable contribution to society and the environment. Together we create living spaces with a future in which people like to live.
We compensate on the market and offer attractive social and salary benefits. The remuneration is based on the function and the relevant experience.
Working hours & holidays With our flexible working models, our employees can combine work and leisure time well. For example, with annual working hours, remote working or unpaid leave.
Career & further education With us many doors are open. We promote specialist and management careers equally and focus on tailor-made training and further education opportunities.
With various childcare services, family allowances and company social counselling, we promote the compatibility of work and family.
Occupational Safety and Health With comprehensive services, we support our employees in maintaining and increasing their physical health and mental fitness.
From staff restaurants to third-party perks, we offer our employees a number of other benefits.
For individual positions (e.g. temporary employment), different employment conditions may apply.
Place of work

## About us
BKW offers its customers internationally complete solutions in the fields of energy, buildings and infrastructure. We employ around 11,500 people. Together we build networks, produce energy, plan and realise energy-efficient buildings and design sustainable living spaces of tomorrow.
For this we need you: people with ideas and commitment. Make a valuable contribution to society and our environment with us!
Discover more
In the BKW Group we live a welcome culture that includes all people. We welcome everyone, regardless of factors such as age, gender, social or ethnic origin, colour, nationality, language, sexual orientation and identity or religion.

• You build, operate and maintain together with your colleagues: the distribution network of BKW

jobs.description:
## Wir machen Lebensräume lebenswert.
Du willst komplexe IT- und OT-Infrastrukturen nicht nur betreiben, sondern aktiv weiterentwickeln? In dieser vielseitigen Rolle sorgst du für stabile, sichere Systeme und bringst deine Erfahrung in anspruchsvolle Projekte ein.

## Deine Aufgaben
• Du betreibst, sicherst und entwickelst unsere On-Premises Datacenter- und Server-Infrastruktur kontinuierlich weiter
• Virtualisierungsumgebungen planst, implementierst und administrierst du ebenso wie unsere NetApp Storage-Landschaft
• Für unsere Systeme konzipierst und optimierst du Backup-Lösungen mit Veeam sowie leistungsfähige Monitoring-Systeme
• Die Windows-Domäne inklusive Active Directory, Zertifikatsdiensten, GPO, DNS und DHCP liegt in deinem Verantwortungsbereich. Zudem betreibst und entwickelst du die Public-Key-Infrastruktur (Zertifikatsdienste) sowie die Multi-Faktor-Authentifizierung (MFA) mittels Smartcard weiter
• Du betreust Linux-Systeme und entwickelst Cybersecurity-Massnahmen im OT- und IT-Umfeld gezielt weiter
• In Infrastrukturprojekten bringst du dein Fachwissen ein, unterstützt im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support und pflegst die technische Dokumentation

## Das bringst du mit
• Eine abgeschlossene Grundbildung als Informatiker:in EFZ, einen Abschluss an einer höheren Fachschule oder Fachhochschule in Informatik oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung als System Engineer, idealerweise in einem OT- oder industrienahen Umfeld
• In Datacenter-, Server- und Virtualisierungstechnologien sowie mit NetApp Storage-Systemen kennst du dich bestens aus
• Du verfügst über sehr gute Linux-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung mit Backup-Lösungen, Monitoring-Systemen und Windows-Domänen; Erfahrung im Client Engineering und in der Software-Paketierung ist von Vorteil
• Dein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Cybersecurity setzt du sicher und praxisnah ein
• Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch sowie auf Englisch
Wir wünschen keine Anfragen von Personaldienstleistern.
• Firma BKW Energie AG
• Arbeitsort Dr. Schneider-Strasse 10, 2560 Nidau
• Pensum 80-100%
• Berufsfeld Informatik
• Anstellungsart Unbefristeter Vertrag
• Referenznummer S-27378

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen
Sinnvolle Tätigkeit Wir leisten einen wertvollen Beitrag für Gesellschaft und Umwelt. Gemeinsam gestalten wir Lebensräume mit Zukunft, in denen Menschen gerne leben.
Vergütung & Sozialleistungen Wir vergüten am Markt und bieten attraktive Sozial- sowie Salärnebenleistungen. Die Vergütung orientiert sich an der Funktion und der relevanten Erfahrung.
Arbeitszeit & Urlaub Mit unseren flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen können unsere Mitarbeitenden Beruf und Freizeit gut miteinander verbinden. Zum Beispiel mit Jahresarbeitszeit, Remote Working oder unbezahltem Urlaub.
Karriere & Weiterbildung Bei uns stehen viele Türen offen. Wir fördern Fach- und Führungslaufbahnen gleichermassen und setzen auf massgeschneiderte Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
Familie & Beruf Mit diversen Kinderbetreuungsangeboten, Familienzulagen sowie einer betrieblichen Sozialberatung fördern wir die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie.
Arbeitssicherheit & Gesundheit Mit umfassenden Dienstleistungen unterstützen wir unsere Mitarbeitenden im Erhalt und in der Steigerung ihrer körperlichen Gesundheit und geistigen Fitness.
Weitere Vorteile Von Personalrestaurant bis zu Vergünstigungen bei Drittfirmen - wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden eine Reihe von weiteren Vorteilen.
Für einzelne Stellen (z.B. befristete Anstellungen) können abweichende Anstellungsbedingungen gelten.
Arbeitsort

## Über uns
Die BKW bietet ihren Kundinnen und Kunden international Gesamtlösungen in den Bereichen Energie, Gebäude und Infrastruktur an. Wir beschäftigen rund 11'500 Mitarbeitende. Gemeinsam bauen wir Netze, produzieren Energie, planen und realisieren energieeffiziente Gebäude und gestalten nachhaltige Lebensräume von morgen.
Dazu brauchen wir Sie: Menschen mit Ideen und Engagement. Leisten Sie mit uns einen wertvollen Beitrag für die Gesellschaft und unsere Umwelt!
Mehr entdecken
Wir leben in der BKW Gruppe eine Willkommenskultur, die alle Menschen einschliesst. Bei uns sind alle willkommen, unabhängig von Faktoren wie Alter, Geschlecht, sozialer oder ethnischer Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Nationalität, Sprache, sexueller Orientierung und Identität oder Religion.

descriptionByLocale.it:
## Facciamo habitat che vale la pena vivere.
Vuoi non solo operare complesse infrastrutture IT e OT, ma svilupparle attivamente? In questo ruolo versatile, si garantisce sistemi stabili e sicuri e portare la vostra esperienza a progetti impegnativi.

## I tuoi compiti
• Potrai continuamente operare, proteggere e sviluppare il nostro centro dati on-premise e infrastruttura server
• Pianificate, implementate e gestite gli ambienti di virtualizzazione e il nostro paesaggio di storage NetApp
• Per i nostri sistemi, progettare e ottimizzare soluzioni di backup con Veeam e potenti sistemi di monitoraggio
• Il dominio Windows tra cui Active Directory, Servizi certificati, GPO, DNS e DHCP è vostra responsabilità. Inoltre, continuerai a operare e sviluppare l'infrastruttura chiave pubblica (servizi certificati) e l'autenticazione multi-fattore (MFA) utilizzando una smart card
• Tu supervisioni i sistemi Linux e sviluppi misure di sicurezza informatica nell'ambiente OT e IT.
• Nei progetti infrastrutturali è possibile portare la vostra esperienza, il supporto in supporto di secondo e terzo livello e mantenere la documentazione tecnica

## Lo porti con te.
• Una formazione di base completa come scienziato informatico: in EFZ, una laurea in una scuola tecnica superiore o un'università in informatica o una qualifica equivalente
• Diversi anni di esperienza come ingegnere di sistema, idealmente in un ambiente OT o industriale
• In data center, server e tecnologie di virtualizzazione e con sistemi di storage NetApp, sei ben diversificato
• Hai una buona conoscenza di Linux così come l'esperienza con soluzioni di backup, sistemi di monitoraggio e domini di Windows; L'esperienza nell'ingegneria client e nell'imballaggio software è un vantaggio
• Si utilizza la vostra forte comprensione della sicurezza informatica in modo sicuro e praticamente
• Lavori in modo indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione e comunichi negoziabili in tedesco e inglese
Non vogliamo richieste da fornitori di servizi di personale.
• Società BKW Energie AG
• Ubicazione Dr. Schneider-Strasse 10, 2560 Nidau
• Ammenda 80-100 %
• Settore professionale Scienza informatica
• Tipo di lavoro Contratto di durata illimitata
• Riferimento S-27378

## Non vedo l'ora.
attività significativa Facciamo un prezioso contributo alla società e all'ambiente. Insieme creiamo spazi vivi con un futuro in cui le persone amano vivere.
Complimentiamo sul mercato e offriamo benefici sociali e salariali attraenti. La remunerazione si basa sulla funzione e sull'esperienza.
Ore lavorative e vacanze Con i nostri modelli di lavoro flessibili, i nostri dipendenti possono combinare il lavoro e il tempo libero bene. Ad esempio, con orari di lavoro annuali, lavoro a distanza o congedo non pagato.
Carriera & ulteriore formazione Con noi molte porte sono aperte. Promuoviamo ugualmente carriere specialistiche e gestionali e ci concentriamo sulla formazione su misura e ulteriori opportunità di istruzione.
Con vari servizi di assistenza all'infanzia, assegni familiari e consulenza sociale aziendale, promuoviamo la compatibilità del lavoro e della famiglia.
Sicurezza e salute sul lavoro Con servizi completi, sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti nel mantenere e aumentare la loro salute fisica e fitness mentale.
Dai ristoranti del personale ai perks di terze parti, offriamo ai nostri dipendenti una serie di altri vantaggi.
Per le posizioni individuali (ad esempio l'occupazione temporanea), possono essere applicate diverse condizioni di lavoro.
Luogo di lavoro

## Informazioni su di noi
BKW offre ai propri clienti soluzioni complete a livello internazionale nel campo dell'energia, degli edifici e delle infrastrutture. Usiamo circa 11.500 persone. Insieme costruiamo reti, produciamo energia, pianifichiamo e realizziamo edifici ad alta efficienza energetica e progettiamo spazi abitativi sostenibili di domani.
Per questo abbiamo bisogno di voi: persone con idee e impegno. Fai un prezioso contributo alla società e al nostro ambiente con noi!
Scopri di più
Viviamo nel Gruppo BKW una cultura di benvenuto che comprende tutte le persone. Accogliamo tutti, indipendentemente da fattori quali età, genere, origine sociale o etnica, colore della pelle, nazionalità, lingua, orientamento sessuale e identità o religione.

## We make habitats worth living.
Do you want to not only operate complex IT and OT infrastructures, but actively develop them? In this versatile role, you ensure stable, secure systems and bring your experience to challenging projects.

## Your tasks
• You will continuously operate, secure and develop our on-premises data center and server infrastructure
• You plan, implement and manage virtualization environments as well as our NetApp storage landscape
• For our systems, design and optimize backup solutions with Veeam as well as powerful monitoring systems
• The Windows domain including Active Directory, Certificate Services, GPO, DNS and DHCP is your responsibility. In addition, you will continue to operate and develop the public key infrastructure (certificate services) as well as multi-factor authentication (MFA) using a smart card
• You supervise Linux systems and develop cybersecurity measures in the OT and IT environment.
• In infrastructure projects you bring your expertise, support in 2nd and 3rd level support and maintain the technical documentation

## You bring that with you
• A completed basic education as a computer scientist: in EFZ, a degree at a higher technical school or university in computer science or an equivalent qualification
• Several years of experience as a system engineer, ideally in an OT or industry-related environment
• In data center, server and virtualization technologies as well as with NetApp storage systems, you are well-versed
• You have very good knowledge of Linux as well as experience with backup solutions, monitoring systems and Windows domains; Experience in client engineering and software packaging is an advantage
• You use your strong understanding of cybersecurity securely and practically
• You work independently, structured and solution-oriented and communicate negotiable in German and English
We do not want requests from personnel service providers.
• Company BKW Energie AG
• Location Dr. Schneider-Strasse 10, 2560 Nidau
• Pensum 80-100 %
• Professional field Computer Science
• Type of employment Contract of unlimited duration
• Reference S-27378

## You can look forward to that.
meaningful activity We make a valuable contribution to society and the environment. Together we create living spaces with a future in which people like to live.
We compensate on the market and offer attractive social and salary benefits. The remuneration is based on the function and relevant experience.
Working hours & holidays With our flexible working models, our employees can combine work and leisure well. For example, with annual working hours, remote working or unpaid leave.
Career & further education With us many doors are open. We promote specialist and management careers equally and focus on tailor-made training and further education opportunities.
With various childcare services, family allowances and company social counselling, we promote the compatibility of work and family.
Occupational Safety and Health With comprehensive services, we support our employees in maintaining and increasing their physical health and mental fitness.
From staff restaurants to third-party perks, we offer our employees a number of other benefits.
For individual positions (e.g. temporary employment), different employment conditions may apply.
Place of work

## About us
BKW offers its customers internationally complete solutions in the fields of energy, buildings and infrastructure. We employ around 11,500 people. Together we build networks, produce energy, plan and realise energy-efficient buildings and design sustainable living spaces of tomorrow.
For this we need you: people with ideas and commitment. Make a valuable contribution to society and our environment with us!
Discover more
We live in the BKW Group a welcome culture that includes all people. We welcome everyone, regardless of factors such as age, gender, social or ethnic origin, skin colour, nationality, language, sexual orientation and identity or religion.

jobs.description:
## Steuerung der konzernweiten AI-Transformation & Innovation
Du möchtest AI auf Konzernebene prägen? In dieser Schlüsselrolle entwickelst du zukunftsweisende Strategien, förderst Innovation, vernetzt Menschen und Ideen und schaffst nachhaltigen Geschäftsnutzen für das gesamte Unternehmen.

## Dein Wirkungsfeld
• Gesamtverantwortung für AI-Transformation & Innovation (Strategie, Roadmap, Budget, KPIs, Risiken)
• Entwicklung und Umsetzung der AI-Strategie auf Konzernebene
• AI-Innovation fördern durch Identifikation, Priorisierung und Skalierung von AI Use Cases entlang der Wertschöpfungskette
• Etablierung von AI Governance-, Compliance- und Operating-Modellen
• Förderung einer datengetriebenen, innovativen Unternehmenskultur inkl. Change Management
• Aufbau eines konzernweiten Netzwerks und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Management und Stakeholdern
• Führung internationaler, interdisziplinärer Teams und Communities

## Deine Stärken
• Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Wirtschaft, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet
• Mindestens 10 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Transformation, Digitalisierung, AI, Innovation oder Consulting
• Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung von grossen Konzernprogrammen
• Nachweisbare Erfolge bei Skalierung digitaler Lösungen mit Business Impact
• Fundiertes Technologieverständnis (AI, Daten, Automatisierung, Plattformen) sowie starke Kompetenzen in Programm-, Change- und Stakeholder-Management (bis C-Level)

## Lehrstart August 2027 (Wilderswil)
Netzelektrikerinnen und Netzelektriker bei der BKW sorgen für den Bau, Betrieb und Unterhalt des Stromnetzes. Freue dich auf spannende Herausforderungen und ein eingespieltes Team, das dich auf deinem Weg zur Fachperson begleitet.

## Deine Aufgaben
Als Spezialistin oder Spezialist für alle Arbeiten am Stromnetz bist du für den Bau, Betrieb und Unterhalt von Kabel- und Freileitungen, von Schalt- und Transformatorenstationen sowie für öffentliche Beleuchtungen zuständig. Ob in der Stadt oder auf dem Land, du bist fast täglich unterwegs und im Freien tätig - im Sommer sowie im Winter. Du entdeckst somit die ganze Welt der elektrischen Energie und kannst mit Mut neue Wege gehen. Trotz technischer Hilfsmittel legst du auch oft selber Hand an und findest selbstständig einen Weg, die Probleme zu lösen. Um Risiken in deiner herausfordernden Tätigkeit zu minimieren, lernst du den sicheren Umgang mit Werkzeugen und Maschinen.
Sei es im Kabelgraben oder auf den Freileitungsmasten: Als Netzelektrikerin oder Netzelektriker arbeitest du meistens in der Gruppe. Da ist gute Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gefragt.

In qualità di specialista per tutti i lavori sulla rete elettrica, si è responsabili per la costruzione, il funzionamento e la manutenzione di cavi e linee aeree, stazioni di commutazione e trasformatori e illuminazione pubblica. ## Start of teaching August 2027 (Wilderswil)
Grid electricians at BKW ensure the construction, operation and maintenance of the power grid. Look forward to exciting challenges and a well-established team that will accompany you on your way to becoming a specialist.

## Your tasks
As a specialist for all work on the power grid, you are responsible for the construction, operation and maintenance of cable and overhead lines, switch and transformer stations and public lighting. Whether in the city or in the countryside, you are almost daily on the road and outdoors - in summer and winter. You will thus discover the whole world of electrical energy and can courageously break new ground. Despite technical aids, you often put on your own hand and find a way to solve the problems independently. In order to minimize risks in your challenging job, you learn how to use tools and machines safely.
Be it in the cable trench or on the overhead line masts: As a grid electrician, you usually work in the group. Good cooperation and mutual trust are needed.

## Lehrstart August 2027 (Wilderswil)
Netzelektrikerinnen und Netzelektriker bei der BKW sorgen für den Bau, Betrieb und Unterhalt des Stromnetzes. Freue dich auf spannende Herausforderungen und ein eingespieltes Team, das dich auf deinem Weg zur Fachperson begleitet.

## Deine Aufgaben
Als Spezialistin oder Spezialist für alle Arbeiten am Stromnetz bist du für den Bau, Betrieb und Unterhalt von Kabel- und Freileitungen, von Schalt- und Transformatorenstationen sowie für öffentliche Beleuchtungen zuständig. Ob in der Stadt oder auf dem Land, du bist fast täglich unterwegs und im Freien tätig - im Sommer sowie im Winter. Du entdeckst somit die ganze Welt der elektrischen Energie und kannst mit Mut neue Wege gehen. Trotz technischer Hilfsmittel legst du auch oft selber Hand an und findest selbstständig einen Weg, die Probleme zu lösen. Um Risiken in deiner herausfordernden Tätigkeit zu minimieren, lernst du den sicheren Umgang mit Werkzeugen und Maschinen.
Sei es im Kabelgraben oder auf den Freileitungsmasten: Als Netzelektrikerin oder Netzelektriker arbeitest du meistens in der Gruppe. Da ist gute Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gefragt.

## Das bringst du mit
• Real- oder Sekundarschlabschluss mit guten mathematischen Fähigkeiten
• Gutes technisches Verständnis und Deutschniveau von mind. B2 bei Lehrbeginn
• Freude an handwerklicher Arbeit und Tätigkeiten im Freien
• Zuverlässig und gerrne im Team unterwegs
• Firma BKW Energie AG
• Arbeitsort Wengelacherweg 18, 3812 Wilderswil
• Pensum 100
• Quereinstieg Möglich
• Berufsfeld Netz
• Position Berufseinsteiger:in
• Anstellungsart Ausbildung, Lehre,Zweitausbildung
• Referenznummer S-27174

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen
Sinnvolle Tätigkeit Wir leisten einen wertvollen Beitrag für Gesellschaft und Umwelt. Gemeinsam gestalten wir Lebensräume mit Zukunft, in denen Menschen gerne leben.
Vergütung & Sozialleistungen Wir vergüten am Markt und bieten attraktive Sozial- sowie Salärnebenleistungen. Die Vergütung orientiert sich an der Funktion und der relevanten Erfahrung.
Arbeitszeit & Urlaub Mit unseren flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen können unsere Mitarbeitenden Beruf und Freizeit gut miteinander verbinden. Zum Beispiel mit Jahresarbeitszeit, Remote Working oder unbezahltem Urlaub.
Karriere & Weiterbildung Bei uns stehen viele Türen offen. Wir fördern Fach- und Führungslaufbahnen gleichermassen und setzen auf massgeschneiderte Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
Familie & Beruf Mit diversen Kinderbetreuungsangeboten, Familienzulagen sowie einer betrieblichen Sozialberatung fördern wir die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie.

Die BKW bietet ihren Kundinnen und Kunden international Gesamtlösungen in den Bereichen Energie, Gebäude und Infrastruktur an. Wir beschäftigen rund 11'500 Mitarbeitende. ## Début de l'enseignement août 2027 (Wilderswil)
Les électriciens de BKW assurent la construction, l'exploitation et l'entretien du réseau électrique. Réjouissez-vous de défis passionnants et d'une équipe bien établie qui vous accompagnera sur votre chemin pour devenir un spécialiste.

## Vos tâches
En tant que spécialiste de tous les travaux sur le réseau électrique, vous êtes responsable de la construction, de l'exploitation et de l'entretien des câbles et des lignes aériennes, des postes de commutation et de transformateur et de l'éclairage public. Que ce soit en ville ou à la campagne, vous êtes presque tous les jours sur la route et en plein air - en été et en hiver. Vous découvrirez ainsi le monde entier de l'énergie électrique et pourrez courageusement briser de nouveaux terrains. Malgré les aides techniques, vous mettez souvent de votre propre main et trouvez un moyen de résoudre les problèmes indépendamment.
